caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of patterned fabric placed on a plain background. The fabric features vertical stripes alternating between yellow and off-white colors. The stripes are decorated with floral and botanical motifs in red and brown tones, with additional details in black and gray. The texture of the fabric is visible, giving a sense of its material. In the top right corner, the fabric is folded over, revealing a plain, light greenish underside. Attached to the fold is a blue and white rectangular label depicting a landscape scene with writing, including the words "EAST COLOURS." Near the bottom right corner, the name “J.V. LUBRANO” is written.
